metadata.description: Marketplace for the Seascape SEO OS plugin that packages the repo's five-role workflow and active local skills.

plugins.name: seascape-seo-os
plugins.description: Seascape SEO OS: the five-role workflow (Search Operator, SEO Architect, Page Builder, Voice Editor, Release Gate) and the sixteen active site-specific skills, packaged for portable install across machines and forks. Content and release verification use explicit repo commands; neither the plugin nor committed .claude/settings.json registers the removed content-voice Stop hook.
